scope: Static binary/source inspection plus host execution of production filter/navigation headers; no phone or server changes by this audit
observations: R69 enterFolderGames already performs invalidate, rebuildHook, firstFolderGame and refreshHook. Adding another reset at the same location does not address later native rebuilds.

00331bac_GuiStore__update.c calls CatalogService::update, optionally swapPendingCatalog, then rebuildVisible (line 114). A subsequent catalog revision can therefore rebuild after the explicit first-game reset.
rebuildVisible at 0x21b7f4 through 0x21b830 restores the selected catalog index in its wider native result. It writes that wider-list position to cursor and animation at 0x21b930 and 0x21b934.

R69 native_folders.h::filterFolderGames shrinks the platform list to one collection but retains the wider-list cursor, clamping invalid positions to visible-1. R69 native_search_state.h::stationSearchScope has the same selection loss when removing other platforms or non-installed items.

Concrete reproduced sequence: collection visible indices [2,4], cursor 0; native rebuild expands to platform indices [0,1,2,4], restoring selected index 2 at cursor 2; old collection filter shrinks to [2,4] then clamps cursor 2 to 1, the last game.
refreshTexts reads the cursor but contains no direct cursor write in the inspected body. The historical R39 harness did not model the native identity restore followed by filter compaction.
The pending restore ID at 0x630 is consumed by the native rebuild. This fix does not alter it because its modification is unnecessary for the reproduced defect.
fix: Both filters capture the selected catalog index before overwriting the visible vector and record its new position while retaining entries.
If compaction removes the selected item, or the old selection is invalid, select the first remaining item (0), also safe for an empty list.
When compaction changes positions, update cursor and animation together; retain the original cache invalidation. Without compaction and with a valid selection, preserve the ongoing animation.
Keep firstFolderGame on fresh entry and preserve Back restoration by stable folder path plus kind. No per-frame reset or selection lock is added.
